title: Delhi High Court Restrains 'Indian Zeera' Maker From Copying 'Lahori Zeera' Trade Dress
case_name: Archian Foods Private Limited v. Goldenstuff and Beverages Private Limited & Ors.
card_summary: Justice Vikas Mahajan granted an ad-interim injunction restraining Goldenstuff and Beverages from using packaging, colour scheme and bottle shape that imitate Archian Foods' 'Lahori Zeera' range. The court found the adoption of a deceptively similar trade dress by a recent market entrant was ex facie mala fide. The order covers the defendants' bottle design and LAHORI-formative marks until the next hearing.
card_tip: Clear trade dress, including label colour scheme and bottle shape, against competing products before launch; close imitation of an established rival's packaging invites an ad-interim injunction on the first hearing.
verification_notes: Confirmed from three independent reports (LiveLawBiz, SupremeToday.ai, PRIMELEGAL) that agree on the parties, the October 8, 2026 order date, the 'mala fide' finding on the trade dress, and the scope of the restraint. The CS(COMM) 1105/2026 case number is given only by the PRIMELEGAL report; it should be checked against the court record.
